# hetznerrobot_storagebox_snapshot_plan (Resource)

The automatic snapshot plan of a Storage Box — every box has exactly one, so this resource adopts it; destroying it disables the plan. Times are in UTC; a schedule field left out matches every value (no `day_of_week` = every day). Only the inclusive **BX10 (100 GB)** Storage Box of a dedicated server is still managed through Robot; every other Storage Box moved to the [Hetzner Console API](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/hetzner#storage-boxes) (the `hcloud` provider). Every Storage Box write is limited to one request per 5 seconds, which the provider waits out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Nightly at 03:30 UTC, keeping the last seven snapshots.
resource "hetznerrobot_storagebox_snapshot_plan" "nightly" {
  storagebox_id = hetznerrobot_storagebox.backup.id
  status        = "enabled"
  minute        = 30
  hour          = 3
  max_snapshots = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `status` (String) `enabled` or `disabled`. A disabled plan has no schedule, so the schedule fields must be left out.
- `storagebox_id` (Number) Storage Box the plan belongs to.

### Optional

- `day_of_month` (Number) Day of the month of the run (1–31).
- `day_of_week` (Number) Weekday of the run, 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday.
- `hour` (Number) Hour of the run (0–23). Required when enabled.
- `max_snapshots` (Number) Maximum number of automatic snapshots kept; the oldest is deleted beyond it.
- `minute` (Number) Minute of the run (0–59). Required when enabled.
- `month` (Number) Month of the run, 1 = January.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_storagebox_snapshot_plan.nightly 123456
```
